description:
Recent regulatory disclosures from the local finbridge database (filings table, refreshed nightly + intraday for KR), newest first — positioned as a faster-than-news primary source. By default returns only MATERIAL filings: US Form 8-K (current reports) and KR 주요사항보고서 (major events: capital raises, M&A, convertible bonds, buybacks, etc.).

Args:
  - market: 'kr' (DART), 'us' (EDGAR), or 'all' (default)
  - company: optional — restrict to one company (US ticker, KR 6-digit code, or name). Takes priority over watchlist.
  - material_only: default true (8-K / KR type-B only); false = all filing types
  - forms: optional explicit form_type filter (e.g. ['10-K','8-K'] or ['A','B']); overrides material_only
  - days: look-back window in days, 1-120 (default 14); or use from/to
  - from/to: optional explicit YYYY-MM-DD range (overrides days)
  - limit: 1-100 (default 30); response_format: 'markdown'|'json'
  - brief: default true — attach the plain-language fact summary (headline_en/headline_ko/facts_en/facts_ko/company_en/event_type) where one exists. Rows without a summary are unaffected. The markdown rendering shows the English side; both sides stay in the JSON.
  - watchlist: default false — restrict to the authenticated account's watchlist companies instead of all companies. Needs a personal API key (not the admin token). Ignored when 'company' is also given.

Returns: {count, market, since, rows:[{source, company_name, form_type, title, filed_date, url, items?, headline_en?, headline_ko?, facts_en?, facts_ko?, company_en?, event_type?}]}. 'items' (8-K item codes) is included when available. Summary fields are present only for filings that have one.
Note: with brief:true, a filing that only exists as a summary (not yet in our filings index) can still appear — such rows omit form_type/items and, for non-DART sources, url.

Examples:
  - Latest US material events this week: {market:'us', days:7}
  - Samsung's recent major-event filings: {company:'005930', material_only:true, days:90}
  - All of a company's filings: {company:'AAPL', material_only:false}
  - My watchlist's recent disclosures with summaries: {watchlist:true}

Use when: scanning for catalysts / breaking corporate events, or one company's recent filings. Don't use for filing BODIES (open the url) or for financial statement values (get_dart_financials / get_edgar_financials / query_db).
Notes: Filing metadata only; bodies are at the linked source URLs. Not investment advice.
Errors: empty result is not an error (count 0).

brief.description: Attach the fact-summary fields where one exists (default true). Rows without a summary are unaffected.

company.description: Optional company filter: US ticker, KR 6-digit code, or name

material_only.description: Only material filings (US 8-K / KR type-B). Default true

watchlist.description: Restrict to the authenticated account's watchlist companies (default false). Needs a personal API key. Ignored when 'company' is set.
